The real danger is p3's Mediterranean/Baltic hotels and p4's green monopoly building toward huge rents, so I need to balance aggressive building against staying liquid enough to survive a bad landing, since I can't realistically cover a $900+ rent hit regardless.

I'll keep it to one step at a time rather than overcomplicating — start by mortgaging Kentucky first.
